gate_type: CORRECTION gate — R3-C01 reset-generation projection epoch (SA review finding on Issue #81 comment 5643455951). Narrow additive lifecycle seam; no architecture redesign.
architecture_authority_ref: Issue #81 comment 5643455951 (SA review: R3 requires C01 before PASS) + Issue #78 (R0 CLOSED/frozen) + Issue #80 (R2 CLOSED) + Issue #82 (R2V PASS)
objective: Remove the poll-timing dependence of the canonical output projection epoch. Expose a monotonically increasing reset_generation / reset_epoch on the canonical RuntimeSession (the ONE reset authority), incremented exactly when RuntimeSession.reset() succeeds, keeping the same run_id and all existing reset semantics. CanonicalAssyOutput derives its projection epoch directly from that authoritative generation instead of inferring a reset from poll-to-poll time/step regression. The output stays downstream/read-only (observes lifecycle metadata, never drives reset) and no second lifecycle authority is created. new_attempt/replay start epoch 1 under their fresh canonical run ids, and the canonical binding bound into newly created bridges is recomputed after the epoch change so no stale prior-run epoch metadata is bound.
explicit_non_objectives: No change to G22 run identity semantics (no run_id change on reset)
No second lifecycle authority (no reset counter on the projection side)
No change to AssyLineRuntime, R1 production driver/profile, G4 coordinator, federation, domain facts
forbidden_actions: Infer the projection epoch from poll-to-poll time/step regression
Create a second lifecycle authority or projection-owned reset
Drive reset/step from the output path
stop_conditions: The authoritative reset generation cannot be exposed without changing G22 run identity semantics
The seam would require a second reset authority
R3 evidence cannot be reproduced under the corrected epoch semantics
Any R1/R2/R2V/R3 regression cannot remain green without weakening an accepted assertion

acceptance_criteria.description: Monotonic reset_generation / reset_epoch on the canonical RuntimeSession, incremented exactly when reset() succeeds, run_id unchanged, new_attempt/replay start at 1

CanonicalAssyOutput derives its projection epoch from the canonical reset generation (not poll-timing inference): poll at S -> reset -> re-step to identical S without polling -> poll yields a new epoch with collision-free newly emitted facts
new_attempt/replay after a prior epoch > 1 start at epoch 1 (envelope + emitted keys + payload metadata), with the canonical binding recomputed after the fresh-run epoch change
Output remains read-only and single-authority: no second runtime/session/federation/controller, no output-driven mutation, repeated poll idempotent
R1/R2/R2V/R3 regressions, full suite and the complete canonical baseline remain green
